message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: adult male (汪某某) in a house, after drinking, touches a minor girl's chest and genital area, forces her onto a bed, continues molestation. The father intervenes. This is sexual assault on a minor: "猥亵儿童" which in Chinese criminal law is "强制猥亵儿童罪" (forced indecency with a minor). The examples: earlier similar case: "强制猥亵妇女" gave answer "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". For child, likely "强制猥亵儿童". The answer format: [罪名]强制猥亵儿童<eoa>. Possibly also "猥亵儿童". In Chinese law, the crime is "强制猥亵罪" (if victim is adult) and "强制猥亵儿童罪" (if victim is under 14). So answer: [罪名]强制猥亵儿童<eoa>.
